g.text: Full 2×2 contrasts: grid and time step
C1/C0: connected/blocked; B1/B0: salinity buoyancy retained/suppressed. Δconn(B) = C1B − C0B; Δint = Δconn(B1) − Δconn(B0).
Ranges are finite scenario ranges, not confidence intervals or a bound on all parameter uncertainty. P1/P2 are measured-Ks corners.
RH = 0; 24 h; 26 accepted cases. No new experimental validation. Numerical and perturbation envelope includes the coarse grid.
